comment: A MAIN-PHASE COLOSSIFICATION CAST ON A READY ATTACKER COSTS THAT ATTACK. Seven Forests pay {5}{G}{G}; the only creature is a non-sick Birds of Paradise. If 'When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature' were missing anywhere (executor, rollout, or the pre-combat attack projection), Birds would swing for 20 = lethal this turn -- a fake turn-early win. With the tap modelled (responded to with Birds' own mana ability, Permanent::etb_tap_pending: still a mana source this phase, never an attacker), no line wins this turn.
